program: Innofounder (Danmarks Innovationsfond; the former Graduate track is merged into one Innofounder programme)
stopper_list: Each funded founder must have completed higher education, rule of thumb >=120 ECTS, before programme start; students may apply (https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/programmer/innofounder/ ; https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Innofounder-retningslinjer_DK_01.07.26.pdf s1.2.3)

Application must state clearly who applies and who is the rest of the team; Jonas (90 ECTS, no degree) can only be a non-applying team member, so max 2 funded founders = DKK 55,000/month, not 82,500 (guidelines PDF s1.2.2, s1.4)
Diploma or study documentation with expected graduation date per applicant showing >=120 ECTS; missing = rejection without assessment (guidelines PDF s2.2.2)
Each founder owns >=12.5%, documented at start (programme page; guidelines PDF s1.2.2, s4.1)
Each founder works full time, >=37 h/week, during the programme (programme page; guidelines PDF s1.2.2)
Max 10 h/week other education or paid work, week by week (programme page; guidelines PDF s1.2.2)
Company with Danish CVR and NemKonto before start, not needed at application (programme page; guidelines PDF s1.2.1, s4.2)
Company must hold the rights to commercial exploitation of the idea (guidelines PDF s1.2.1)
No founder can be added or swapped after the deadline (guidelines PDF s1.2.2)
A company can be admitted to Innofounder only once (guidelines PDF s1.2.4)

Idea past idea stage with significant development left; no significant/regular revenue or substantial external capital; not mainly sales/marketing/scaling (programme page; guidelines PDF s1.3.2-1.3.3)
Active participation and physical attendance in the sparring/incubation programme (guidelines PDF s1.2.2)
No open call: 25 Aug 2026 12:00 deadline passed, next deadline unpublished; deadlines always weekday 12:00; nothing can be changed after the deadline (programme page; guidelines PDF s2.1, s2.2.4)
e-grant only, one founder registers; CV max 2 pages; extras max 5 pp + LOIs max 5 pp; PDF max 25 MB; form non-compliance = rejection (guidelines PDF s2.1-2.2.3)
Inside the form: theme choice with justification, per-question character limits (1000/1200), mandatory milestone plan (guidelines PDF s1.3.4, s2.2.1)
Company at most 5 years old at grant, incl. controlling parent >50% (guidelines PDF s1.2.1)
State-aid declarations (GBER art. 22): no profit distributed, no takeover/merger, max 49 employees, not a firm in difficulty (guidelines PDF s6)
No hours in another publicly funded project such as Innobooster (guidelines PDF s1.5)
Company must differ markedly from applicants' earlier companies (guidelines PDF s1.2.1)
